name: Box Turn (backward half)
notes: Owner's description: follows Box Turn (forward half); a backward step on the opposite (left) foot with the same quarter turn clockwise, counts 1-2-3, feet closing on 3. No rise. Turn timing from the book (2026-11-17, a box-step study card: the partner going back, on the inside of the turn, "commences to turn" on 1, turns 1/4 between 1 and 2 with the "body turns less", and the body completes the turn on 3; the partner going forward turns 1/8 between 1 and 2 and 1/8 between 2 and 3). Written that way (2026-11-17, to stop the follow lunging round the outside of the turn): the bodies turn 1/24 right on count 1 (the turn commencing), 1/8 on count 2 and 1/12 on the close, a quarter in all; the lead, going back on the inside, points his count-2 foot a further 1/8 (`pointing`); the close's turn is carried back into count 2's foot placement. The couple turns round the lead (the default turning centre, since he goes back). Step sizes, provisional (2026-11-17), chosen by measuring the 3D body solver against the figure checks: count 1 is 0.4 back and 0.2 to his left, so her forward step passes his standing right foot with room to spare as the turn begins; count 2 is 0.6 back and 0.3 left of where his right foot was. Before this change (the owner's first sizes: 0.5 back, then the right foot 0.4 beyond the left in the turned frame, measured as 0.9 back and 0.2 left, with the whole quarter on count 2) the follow's count 2 was a 1.4 m stride that sank her hips 0.74-0.78 m, and her right foot passed 7.6 cm from his. Now the hips sink at most 0.08 m and every check passes; the strides are 0.45, 0.67 and 0.11 for the lead (from his standing foot) and 0.45, 1.01 (from her back foot, round the outside) and 0.39 for the follow.
